title: Gumbel Substitution: Removing Sampler Drift from RL Without Trusting the Sampler
abstract: arXiv:2611.27375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When RL rollouts come from untrusted samplers on arbitrary hardware, precision and checkpoint lag, the sampling distribution $q$ differs from the trainer's policy $p$, and training on the sampler's tokens adds a drift term equal to supervised fine-tuning toward $q$. Published corrections (TIS, MIS, IcePop, score centering, GSPO, CISPO) all need $q(y)$, which a permissionless sampler reports and can misreport. We introduce Gumbel substitution. The coordinator fixes public Gumbel noise for every token position, bit-identical across GPUs, and the sampler draws $y=\arg\max(\ell^q+G)$. The trainer recomputes $v^*=\arg\max(\ell^p+G)$, the token its own policy would have drawn with the same noise, and scores $v^*$ in the sampler's context. For a sampler that follows the protocol, $v^*$ is an exact sample from $p$ given the prefix, so the drift vanishes in expectation for any $q$, without sampler-reported probabilities. translated_title: Gumbel替换：在不信任采样器的情况下消除强化学习中的采样器漂移
translated_abstract: 当强化学习的rollout来自不受信任的采样器（运行在任意硬件上、存在精度和检查点延迟问题）时，采样分布 q 与训练器的策略 p 不同，在采样器的 token 上进行训练会引入一个漂移项，其效果相当于朝向 q 进行监督微调。已发表的修正方法（TIS、MIS、IcePop、分数中心化、GSPO、CISPO）都需要 q(y)，而无许可采样器所报告的 q(y) 可能被误报。我们提出了Gumbel替换方法。协调器为每个 token 位置固定公开的Gumbel噪声，并在所有GPU上保持比特级一致，采样器通过 y=argmax(ℓ^q+G) 抽取样本。训练器重新计算 v*=argmax(ℓ^p+G)，即其自身策略在相同噪声下本应抽取的 token，并在采样器的上下文中对 v* 进行评分。对于遵循协议的采样器，v* 是给定前缀条件下来自 p 的精确样本，因此漂移在期望中对任何 q 都会消失，且无需依赖采样器报告的概率。我们测量了残余的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Gumbel替换方法，由协调器分发比特级一致的公开Gumbel噪声，使训练器能重建其自身策略在相同噪声下的精确token样本，从而在不信任采样器、不依赖其报告概率的情况下，消除强化学习训练中因采样器与训练器策略不一致而产生的漂移。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Gumbel substitution, where a coordinator distributes bit-identical public Gumbel noise so the trainer can reconstruct the exact token its own policy would have sampled, removing sampler drift in RL training without trusting or needing sampler-reported probabilities.
